title: Rogue leopard bursts into off licence before lunging at two men inside
text: Two men have escaped a rogue leopard attack after the animal burst into a tiny liquor store on Sunday morning. The big cat wandered into Todaraisingh town in Rajasthan,India,on July 19,and began attacking locals. One,a local forest ranger volunteer,was investigating reports the leopard had been spotted in bushes at 8:45am when the animal attacked him. The leopard then travelled into the town before making its way inside a liquor store and lunging at the two men inside. Terrifying footage captured the attack,in which 25-year-old salesman Sanjay Gurjar manages to escape the big cat’s claws. He can be seen wrestling away from the leopard,before making a dive over a table the second he is released from its clutches.
